project.title: Identity formula closes as bounded cross-domain constraint, not universal final law
project.hidden_assumption: One identity formula can serve as a final universal law across all target domains

contradiction.proposition_A: One identity formula can serve as a final universal law across all target domains
contradiction.proposition_B: Reviewer rounds preserved only bounded cross-domain constraint pieces
contradiction.why_not_both: The archive frames these as mutually constraining claims; the closeout keeps only the bounded part that survived inspection.
contradiction.resolution: The closeout keeps the reusable identity/constraint graph and kills universality.
